title: Author filter uses a manual raw-query-string fallback
evidence: src/books/core.clj:56-59 re-parses ?author= from :query-string with a regex + URLDecoder even though :query-params already supplies it
suggestion: Rely on Ring's parsed :query-params (wrap-params) alone; the manual fallback is redundant given ring-core is a dependency

title: Create/update depend on SQLite RETURNING *
evidence: src/books/core.clj:66 INSERT ... RETURNING * requires SQLite >= 3.35 (org.xerial/sqlite-jdbc 3.44 pinned in deps.edn)
suggestion: None required; noting the version coupling for portability
